decision_rationale: This is presented as a new pathology multimodal model, not a review or wrapper. The full text says it is a “pathology-expert-level visual language model” that accepts “text prompts” and “pathology image” inputs, with “summarization and cross-modality generation.”
evidence_snippet: “construct a pathology-expert-level visual language model” and “accepts text prompts and pathology image as inputs”; “summarization and cross-modality generation” with pathology images and text prompts in the system description; “integrated information ... confined to text and images” and “transcriptomic profile generation” in evaluation figures/sections
